defects: UniProt offset was hardcoded as +4 instead of derived +5
random_5 assigned positions rather than variant rows
wild-type position 0 was included in folds
holdout was hardcoded to modulo fold 4 and overlapped contiguous training
predecessor.replacement_reason: New write-once manifest correcting all four diagnostics; predecessor retained unchanged.

rule_change.definition: UniProt ACT_SITE, BINDING, METAL, or DISULFID annotation on an aligned domain residue
rule_change.justification: Disulfides are near-absent in this cDNA-display assay; RSA protection returns every candidate and remains soft protection only.

current_rule.description: each random fold spans at least 90% of non-holdout mutable positions

previous_rule.description: each random fold spans more than 60 mutable positions

random_row_fold_guard.reason: The absolute threshold was calibrated on 1IGV and rejected a correct row-random split for 2AMI; relative coverage preserves the order-of-magnitude detector for position-based defects.
